answer_1.quote: We propose to prompt large language models (LLMs) such as to synthesize the samples needed for contrastive learning... prompting LLMs to generate sentences and their corresponding annotations from scratch.
answer_1.outputs: Generated unlabeled sentences, positive samples (paraphrases), and hard negative samples for contrastive learning.

answer_4.quote: To evaluate the safety of our synthetic dataset, we ask five annotators (one of which is a psychological counselor and the other four are postgraduate students) to annotate whether the generated sentences have ethical problems.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to evaluate whether the generated sentences have ethical problems.
